exposure: preoperative 18F-FDG PET-CT imaging parameters (thickness, volume of uterine lesion, SUVmax)
cohort: The study included 151 patients diagnosed with endometrioid-type endometrial cancer who underwent hysterectomy between January 2014 and 2021.
finding: High SUVmax values on preoperative PET-CT imaging were significantly associated with poor prognostic factors like deep myometrial invasion, cervical involvement, LVSI, and LN metastasis, and lower 5-year disease-free and overall survival rates in endometrial cancer patients.
